title: Debug: Revenue Is Missing The Last Day
description:
This is meant to total revenue for every order placed **on or before** 2021-12-31. It's quietly excluding orders placed exactly on that date. Find the bug and fix it.

Name the column `total_revenue` (rounded to 2 decimals). The result is exactly one row.
solutionSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.order_date <= '2021-12-31';
hint: "On or before" means the boundary date itself should be included — that's `<=`, not `<`. A strict less-than silently drops every order dated exactly on the cutoff.

tests.name: Customer who never ordered
All orders cancelled
Orders with no items, products never sold
NULL prices, quantities and statuses
Single customer, single order
Ties in revenue between products and customers
Same-day repeat orders across month and year boundaries
Order exactly on the cutoff date — buggy query excludes it
Orders before cutoff — both queries include them
Orders after cutoff — both queries exclude them
No orders on or before cutoff — both return NULL
Multiple orders, one exactly on cutoff — bug under-reports total
